title: 保存済み合成板の出所訂正: 7203 を実フィード扱いしない

original_preserved.method: cp -p then cmp (exit 0) + sha256sum of both paths equal

source: Yowayowa synthetic seed orderbook (not an exchange feed)

after: Synthetic multi-level depth generated locally; not live exchange data.

provenance corrected 2026-10-23: this stored board previously carried a real-exchange feed label with an official-public licence class. It is locally generated synthetic data; prices, sizes, metrics and timestamps were not modified.

roundtrip_identity.why: the file was written by OrderbookService.record_snapshot with exactly this dumping call; re-serialising reproduces it byte for byte, so the after-file diff is provably confined to the edited provenance lines

formula_identity.check: every level equals base=2850.0, tick=1.0, lot=1000.0 scaffolding: bid price 2850-i, bid size 1000*(1+0.25i), bid order_count 3+i, ask price 2850+i, ask size 1000*(0.9+0.3i), ask order_count 2+i

timestamp_signature.check: as_of == provenance.retrieved_at (both 2026-10-02T13:28:38.939638Z) — the generator stamps both with one datetime.now(UTC); a captured feed would carry a venue as_of distinct from retrieval time

no_real_producer_in_repo.note: src/yowayowa/providers/ contains no L2 orderbook provider for any venue; the only producers of data/orderbooks/*/latest.json are generate_seed_orderbook and the POST /v1/orderbook/{symbol}/snapshots ingest endpoint. The stored 7203 board therefore cannot have come from an exchange feed.

sqlite_secondary_store.result: no orderbook/snapshot-of-orderbook table (only strategy_research_snapshots, portfolio_snapshots); file store is the single source

cli.source_line: As of: 2026-10-02T13:28:38.939638+00:00 (Yowayowa synthetic seed orderbook (not an exchange feed))
cli.note: The CLI 'show' panel prints only provenance.source (its single provenance line, unchanged display code); provider/license_class are exposed by the API. Before the correction this line read 'Yowayowa L2 Orderbook Provider' with no synthetic marker; it now states that the board is not an exchange feed.

regression.normal_path: OrderbookService.get_snapshot on a scratch copy of the corrected file returns provider=synthetic-seed-orderbook / license=synthetic and model_dump equals the stored JSON exactly; no corrupt_reads ledger created
regression.degraded_path: truncated ETH scratch copy -> provider=synthetic-seed-orderbook, license=synthetic, degraded note present, file bytes unchanged, corrupt_reads.jsonl row with matching sha256 (27 bytes)

not_done_by_design: No other stored data was relabelled by inference (only data/orderbooks/7203/latest.json exists).
No new migration/backup mechanism was added to the repo: the preserved copy lives under the existing docs/evidence/YYYYMMDD convention and the correction was a one-shot script outside the repo.
No external re-fetch, order, push, billing, or model-setting change.
